beats.say: ClawDOS is an AI chat and coding harness for DOS running on an IBM PC 5160 with an 8088 at 4.77 MHz, 640K of RAM and CGA, using a bridge PC to handle TLS.
The author built it for fun on the restored IBM PC from his childhood, which now boots from an SD card through a PicoMEM.
Apart from the author's note, the whole repository was written by Claude, as an experiment in how far a coding agent can go under unusual constraints.
